company.shortDescription: Otida is an app that acts as a nutritionist, a fitness coach and physician, among other roles, for patients with diabetes.
company.description: Otida is an app that acts as a nutritionist, a fitness coach and physician, among other roles, for patients with diabetes who struggle while navigating through their day-to-day lives.

productsAndServices.description: A comprehensive care model for type 2 diabetes patients, offering personalized nutrition plans, exercise routines, and continuous monitoring and support by a multidisciplinary team.

productsAndServices.description: Continuous Glucose Monitor readings are used to track patients' blood glucose levels in real-time, allowing for immediate adjustments to treatment plans.
productsAndServices.name: CGM Blood Sugar Readings

productsAndServices.description: Customized dietary guidelines designed to control blood sugar levels, based on individual health data and lifestyle.
productsAndServices.name: Nutrition Plans

productsAndServices.description: Personalized exercise plans tailored to fit the patient's lifestyle and improve their blood sugar control.
productsAndServices.name: Exercise Routines

productsAndServices.description: Ongoing assessment of the patient's health data, including blood sugar levels, diet, and exercise, with the support of a dedicated care team.
productsAndServices.name: Continuous Monitoring and Support

productsAndServices.description: A comprehensive educational program covering diabetes management, nutrition, and lifestyle changes to support patients' understanding of their condition.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Pre Seed round raised $340,000, or 85% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $971,188 to $2,887,713, a 2.97x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 67 (-1 over 90 days) and market heat at 35 (-9).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.title: Competitive benchmark reflects the modeled peer set
insights.statement: Crunchbase’s closest modeled peers include Virta Health, Omada Health, Twin Health.
insights.implication: These matches provide a starting point for comparing differentiation, scale, and shared specialties, but they should not be treated as a verified competitor set.
caveats: Similarity scores are algorithmic matches, not verified direct competitors.
